assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: site_boundary.geojson and key_areas.geojson are provisional (official_boundary=false, geometry_role=provisional_constraint, boundary_precision=provisional_rough).
assumptions.impact: Area, ratio, and length values are recomputable on provisional geometry only; they do not constitute statutory redlines, precise area basis, or approval basis. Official boundary release triggers a full re-computation, not local replacement.

assumptions.statement: The Chinese Family AI Literacy Program (san-li model 千·万·亿), AI+PBL framework, and whole-person education verification are cleared for public open-source submission by the contributor; no personal, minor, or private organisational data are included.
assumptions.impact: These materials are used as demand-side evidence for space typologies (family AI literacy station, youth learning venue, co-creation blank) and 8-80 acceptance criteria, not as planning, industry, or policy basis.
